issues: Delivery addresses a wholly different question: sepsis prognostic models in MIMIC-IV, not EMPA-KIDNEY/empagliflozin durability in CKD.
None of the required sources (PMID 36331190, PMID 39453837, PMID 38061371, KDIGO 2024) are used; unrelated MIMIC-IV publications are substituted.

MustDo requirements are unmet: no review design, searches, eligibility or protocol status for EMPA-KIDNEY; no separate handling of three publications with NCT03594110 as one primary study; no guideline exclusion from primary-study count; no randomized vs post-trial distinction.
No EMPA-KIDNEY outcome data or durability assessment is provided.
Appended Chinese-language section and revision notes are off-topic and not part of a coherent answer to the brief.
judge.rationale: The delivery entirely misses the brief. It appraises sepsis mortality models using MIMIC-IV whereas the brief asks about the EMPA-KIDNEY trial and post-trial follow-up of empagliflozin in CKD. Required sources and mustDo constraints are absent, so usefulness, correctness and evidence handling for this brief are zero. Safety framing is only non-harmful but irrelevant, hence 1.
